# ensemble-trd

> **Mission:** Thin routing layer over the existing TRD-adjacent commands (authoring, refinement, beads-driven implementation, and the cross-artifact analysis/validation/verification/ status/dependency-graph tools). Reads and follows the matching sibling command's own generated file for this runtime, passing the rest of $ARGUMENTS unchanged, and does not re-implement any of their phases. Variants of a command are flags on that command rather than keywords: `create --parser-tables` produces a Foreman-native structured TRD, and `implement --workstream [--generate-only]` generates a normalized executable workstream TRD from multiple source TRDs. This group is intentionally heterogeneous -- not every subcommand below is a simple CRUD variant of one workflow, so read each one's own description carefully before picking it.
